entities.summary: Iceland is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Reykjavík. Official languages include Icelandic. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 0.4 million. Area: 103,000 km². Comprehensive index for Iceland covering Norse settlement (~874 CE, Ingólfr Arnarson), Althingi (930 CE, oldest parliament), Christianisation (1000 CE), Norwegian rule (1262), Kalmar Union, Danish rule, volcanic eruptions (Laki 1783, global cooling), sovereignty 1918, Republic 1944, Cod Wars (vs UK, 1958-76), NATO founding member (no military), 2008 financial crisis (all 3 banks collapsed), Eyjafjallajökull 2010, Panama Papers, and modern Nordic model.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Iceland's sovereignty in 1918 and its adoption of the modern Nordic model have had a significant regional impact on European politics and social welfare. The country's unique history, including its early Christianisation and volcanic eruptions, has also shaped its distinct culture.
